thread:
Maria Gomez: Heads-up — legal asked for clearer 'who/why' on routing policy changes. They want route context surfaced in the console timeline and included in exports. Is this doable? :thinking:

Josh Patel: We can add stable route_ids and include them in audit events. Today we only emit policy_name + actor.

Siva Rao: Short answer: yes. Main tradeoff is payload size. I'd add route_id and a tiny route_summary (3 fields) to events instead of full rule text.

Maria Gomez: What would the route_summary look like? route_id, owner, reason?

Lex Chen: My vote: route_id, owner_id, tier, plus match_keys (comma list). Console quick view shows owner + rule snippet; exports get the compact summary string.

eng-bot: Deploy 6543210001: audit-service schema migration started — adding route_id field to change_event

Josh Patel: Owner_id could be an email (PII). We need pseudonymization for exported bundles unless consumer is permitted.

Siva Rao: Agreed. Proposal: exports carry hashed_owner_id and actor_hash. Console resolves to full email when user has permission. Also retention: compact events in main index (90d), full snapshots pinned to enterprise buckets (365d).

Maria Gomez: Telemetry ask: add metric policy.rollout.affected_routes tagged by route_id? Also surface per-route quota usage in the route details panel.

Lex Chen: Per-route quota tagging is fine, but routing can inherit quotas from account-level. We should show effective quota and source (explicit|inherited).

Josh Patel: API design question: inline route metadata in change_event schema vs separate /route_context endpoint that export consumers can query. Thoughts?

Siva Rao: Separate endpoint reduces event size and lets us version context without re-issuing events. Downside: export consumers want atomic archives. We could support a bundle flag to inline context during export generation.

Maria Gomez: UX: in the console change timeline we should show a collapsed 'route diff' preview (one-line summary like "match: user.email endswith @acme.com -> tier: premium") with an expand chevron for full rule.

Lex Chen: Example compact event (for discussion):

```
{
  "change_event_id": "chg_0a1b2c",
  "actor_hash": "sha256:...",
  "route": {
    "route_id": "rt_1234",
    "summary": "owner=acct:eng-team;tier=premium;match=email:*@acme.com"
  },
  "timestamp": "2026-03-21T18:00:00Z"
}
```

Josh Patel: I'll draft a short spec for exports noting pseudonymization, bundle-flag, and retention tiers and share with security & e-discovery.

Maria Gomez: Action items — Siva: open schema PR to add route_id + summary; Lex: implement collapsed route preview in console (mockups first); Josh: export spec + legal/security review; I'll coordinate with Legal. :thumbsup:

Siva Rao: noted. I'll include migration plan and a sampling config to avoid always inlining full summaries.

Lex Chen: I'll build the UI stub and add instrumentation events for telemetry.

eng-bot: CI pipeline queued for branch/audit-route-context (build #1123) :eyes:

Maria Gomez: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after PRs land and once Josh posts the spec.
